messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert firing: PD#GPU-ALLOC-7321 - high CUDA OOM rate on gpu-pool-west2a. auto-escalation -> oncall.
pagerduty: Paging ashley (oncall) for PD#GPU-ALLOC-7321 — severity: P1 — repeat alerts every 2m.
ashley: ack — looking. seeing a spike of cudaAlloc failures in the metrics dashboard, +50% in the last 3m. tagging raj for kvcache/eviction suspicion.
raj: on it. pulling tail of driver logs from node gpu-03 and the runtime logs for inference-service-redwood-v2.
ashley: customer impact? any 5xx or latency spikes shown on frontend?
emily: startup - I see increased 502s for customers on model-redwood-13b in west2 region, ~8% error rate and higher latencies on tail. Kicking a small diagnostic query set to repro.
raj: logs from gpu-03: ```
E CUDA: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory (error 2)\nW kvcache: reassign evict list length=0\nI runtime: model load attempts: 3, lastLoadMs=12000
```
raj: also seeing aggressive prefetch on the runtime: prefetch batch sizes jumped from 4->32 in last minute, probably due to sudden traffic pattern.
ashley: can we temporarily throttle prefetch or backoff batching to reduce mem pressure? what's the config key?
raj: config key is `runtime.prefetch.max_inflight` and `batcher.max_batch_size`. setting prefetch to 8 and batch size to 8 should cut peak mem. I'm going to roll a safe hotfix to the runtime config for west2a only.
jordan: +1 for regional config change; prefer not to restart pods if possible. raj — can you apply config via k8s rollout patch?
raj: applying: ```
kubectl -n inference patch cm runtime-config --patch '{"data":{"runtime.prefetch.max_inflight":"8","batcher.max_batch_size":"8"}}' && rollout restart deployment/inference-service-redwood-v2 -n inference --namespace inference --selector=region=west2a --grace-period=60
```
ashley: tagging cc-billing — this may cause throttling and reduced throughput for some customers temporarily. cc_billing: please watch for customer complaints.
cc-billing: ack — watching customer helpdesk and usage dashboards. will escalate if payment-impacting customers are affected.
emily: after config patch I'm seeing alloc errors drop on gpu-03 and a couple nodes, mem headroom increased ~15%. latency also starting to normalize.
ashley: good. I want to confirm no ongoing memory leak: raj, can you enable a short-term extra prometheus scrape for per-process RSS and nvml GPU memory on 5s resolution for 30m?
raj: done: `prom-client scrape override applied -> 5s for inference pods in west2a`
emily: running a few long-running evals to watch for creeping RSS. so far stable for 10m.
sre-shift-lead: heading in for handoff in 10m. ashley — what's the plan for next hour?
ashley: plan: monitor for 30m, keep prefetch throttled, if errors stay under 1% we'll gradually relax back to defaults over 1 hour. open follow-up task for postmortem and config ratchet. assign to raj + emily.
ashley: paging status -> resolved? not fully resolved but degraded OK. I'm going to mark PD#GPU-ALLOC-7321 as acknowledged and in-progress.
pagerduty: PD#GPU-ALLOC-7321 status: acknowledged by ashley at 6954321002.
jordan: one more mitigation idea — add an autoshedder rule to drop non-critical batched prefetch jobs on mem>85%. file a runtime change ticket if we want to keep.
ashley: agreed. create RFC for autoshedder and automated rollback thresholds. raj/emily will own.
emily: created ticket RED-INC-2891: "investigate prefetch surge -> autoshedder RFC" assigned raj/emily. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-INC-2891
ashley: recording short incident notes: root cause suspected sudden traffic pattern causing aggressive prefetch -> batch growth -> memory pressure -> cudaAlloc OOMs. mitigation: regional prefetch throttle + batch size cap; monitoring increased.
sre-shift-lead: taking handoff at 6954321030. ashley — anything else to add?
ashley: no, handing off. I'll send a short summary to #incidents later and postmortem template in 24h. thanks team. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident redwood/PD#GPU-ALLOC-7321 created with severity P1, linked ticket RED-INC-2891.
